queries: WITH g AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ReportsTo), s AS (SELECT ReportsTo, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g) SELECT ReportsTo, cnt AS employee_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_avg FROM s ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Employees with NULL ReportsTo are excluded before grouping, as the request states. The average share is the mean of the per-group shares, taken over the groups that remain.
Ties in the difference have no specified order, so their order is arbitrary.

assumptions.assumption: Employees with NULL ReportsTo are excluded before grouping, so they do not affect the total or the average share.
The average share is the unweighted mean of the per-group shares (equal to 1 divided by the number of groups). Ties in the difference are broken arbitrarily.
